sourceVerifiedThrough.meaning: Oldest date on which every current research or source claim was last semantically reviewed; this is not a content-edit date.

contentRevisionThrough.meaning: Latest revision date among the bundled curriculum documents; this does not assert that research or sources were reverified.

verifiedThrough.meaning: Deprecated compatibility alias for sourceVerifiedThrough; it is not an independent verification claim and never limits content revisions.
